items.title: AI-Related Stocks Are Soaring After OpenAI’s Astra Model Release
items.summary: Stocks tied to AI are having a big day amid growing enthusiasm over OpenAI's latest model, called Astra. Shares of CoreWeave, an AI cloud infrastructure company, rose 15% Tuesday. Shares of Lumentum and Coherent, which manufacture optical and laser equipment used by AI data centers, were up 12% and 9% respectively.

items.title: Amgen, Novartis, Qualcomn, Corning, Lumentum, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
items.summary: Stocks declined on Tuesday as oil prices rose, renewing investor worries about hotter inflation and bolstering the case for the Federal Reserve to hike interest rates.  Investor attention may turn to  Apple  on Wednesday when the company holds its iPhone launch event.  Artificial-intelligence stocks were advancing despite the market’s inflation worries.

items.title: Which Optics Stock Has Dominated in 2026: Applied Optoelectronics, Lumentum, or Coherent?
